ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (25) has a matching target block; 2 page marker(s) preserved in place; 5 numbered section(s); attributions: John 8:26–28, Emerson, Fyodor Strakhov, One must live the short span of this life by the law of eternal life, Thoreau.
Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (register, omissions, glosses, attribution form).

Gospel wording is translated from Tolstoy's Russian with the source's lowercase «сын человеческий» (son of man) and «отец» (father) (D0002); the italic «я» (ya, 'I') in the teacher's saying is kept as italic *I*.
